name: Root River (Minnesota)
gaugeName: Root River near Pilot Mound, MN

gaugeContext.note: USGS 05383950 is beside the Moen’s Bridge area. It provides reference flow for the Root River, not a calibrated travel speed. Tributaries, including the South Branch, change flow farther downstream. It does not establish passage at Brightsdale.

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed calibration or numeric trip-time range is assigned. General river descriptions do not establish a float duration.

blurb: Explore Root River paddles from Chatfield and Lanesboro through Whalan, Rushford, Houston and Hokah. Compare short outings and longer DNR-listed trips, with public access areas, reference flow and section-specific access and hazard notes.

sections.notes: A DNR-recommended paddle through forest and pasture. Arrange a shuttle and identify the Moen’s Bridge exit before starting. This trip finishes upstream of the Brightsdale portage area.

distanceEvidence.note: The recommended trip publishes 13.3 miles (78.6 minus 65.3). Inventory mile 78.4 for Parsley is not mixed into that distance. River miles are approximate and exclude carries and shuttle travel.

putInAccess.directions: Use the public carry-in at the Highway 52 crossing south of Chatfield. DNR identifies the right bank facing downstream. Inspect the signed approach and shoreline during your shuttle; this marker identifies the general access area.

takeOutAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Root River map 1 and public water-access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency coordinate retained unchanged near the bridge and riverbank. Canopy and the facility-level coordinate do not resolve an exact landing. Use County Road 21 as labelled on the published map; the inventory calls it Hwy 21.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the public carry-in at the County Road 21 bridge west of Lanesboro. DNR identifies the right bank facing downstream. Locate the signed access and exit before launching; the wooded water-edge landing is not precisely resolved.

sections.difficulty: Portage advised at Brightsdale; moving water
sections.notes: A longer DNR-listed day trip with a current portage advisory at the former Brightsdale Dam. Check agency updates and the signed portage before committing. Access areas are shown; a continuous paddling path through this work area is withheld.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Root River recommended trips
distanceEvidence.streamId: Root River State Water Trail, Minnesota
distanceEvidence.note: The DNR trip webpage publishes 15.8 miles (65.3 minus 49.5). The 2026 map marks Whalan at 49.4 and GIS at 49.3. Retain the stated trip length rather than mixing sources; portage and shuttle distance are separate.

notices.title: Brightsdale: portage advised
notices.text: DNR’s October 8, 2026 alert says unexpected rapids at the former Brightsdale Dam near mile 60 make passage difficult. Portage around the area using upstream signs; check current guidance before your trip.

notices.title: Whalan parking is separate
notices.text: Allow for carrying your boat: DNR places parking about 500 feet from the Whalan carry-in. Identify the left-bank exit during your shuttle.

sections.routeReview: Continuous river path withheld through the Brightsdale portage area. Access-area markers do not indicate that the entire reach can be paddled.

sections.difficulty: Moving water; bridge debris and dredging caution
sections.notes: DNR recommends this longer day paddle through wooded banks and farmland. Arrange your vehicle shuttle and identify the Houston exit before launching. Start at the signed Rushford launch below the submerged dam.

notices.title: Start below the Rushford dam
notices.text: The map places a submerged dam at river mile 33.9 and the Rushford launch at 33.8, just downstream. Confirm the signed launch before entering the water.

notices.title: Bridge debris and dredging area
notices.text: DNR marks abandoned railway-bridge debris near mile 22.5 and a sand-dredging caution near mile 18.8, just before the Houston exit. Scout and check current local guidance; the river-course overview does not choose a passage through either area.

distanceEvidence.streamId: Root River State Water Trail, Minnesota
distanceEvidence.note: The DNR trip guide publishes 15.1 miles (33.8 minus 18.7); the access inventory labels Rushford 35.1, which is not used. Agency course geometry independently measures about 15.1 miles between the source coordinates. Carries and shuttle mileage are excluded.

sections.routeReview: Approximate DNR water-trail course. Exact landing connections and passage around obstacles are not drawn; the line is not a recommended navigation channel.

putInAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
putInAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Root River map 2 and public water-access inventory
putInAccess.note: The unchanged DNR coordinate matches the wooded access approach below the visible upstream structure. Canopy obscures the exact water-edge landing. The inventory river mile is 35.1, but the 2026 map and recommended trip use 33.8. The DNR course from this coordinate to Houston measures about 15.1 miles, matching the published trip rather than the inventory mile label.
putInAccess.directions: Use the public carry-in west of Rushford: DNR directs visitors west on Highway 16, then south on the gravel access road. The published map places this left-bank launch immediately downstream of a submerged dam. Confirm the signed launch before entering the water; do not start above the dam.

takeOutAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Root River map 2 and public water-access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Unchanged DNR GPS facility coordinate sits at a wooded bank beside the approach clearing. The precise landing is obscured, so retain an approximate area. Do not substitute the south-bank trailhead parking for the north-bank boating access.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the public carry-in on the north side of Houston at the Highway 76 bridge. DNR places it on the left bank facing downstream. Locate the signed exit and arrange your shuttle before launching. The Root River State Trail trailhead is a separate site across the river.

sections.notes: A shorter lower Root outing from Houston to County Road 25. The river passes the South Fork confluence. Arrange a shuttle and confirm the Mound Prairie bank and signed exit before starting.

notices.title: Confirm the Mound Prairie access bank
notices.text: The DNR coordinate and the published river-bank label disagree. Use the signed public access at County Road 25 and confirm the bank during your shuttle; the map marks an approximate area.

takeOutAccess.note: Agency GPS coordinate retained unchanged at the visible carry-in clearing. The inventory and printed map label the site river-right, but the coordinate lies north of the mapped downstream course, on its left bank. That source conflict prevents an exact landing or verified-bank claim despite the visible shoreline approach.
takeOutAccess.directions: Reach the signed public access at the County Road 25 bridge east of Houston. The agency marker is beside the north-bank clearing west of the bridge. DNR’s river-bank label conflicts with that position; confirm the signed launch and bank during your shuttle. This is an approximate access-area marker.

sections.notes: Follow the lower Root from County Road 25 toward Hokah. Confirm the signed Mound Prairie put-in and the city carry-in takeout during your shuttle. The access map does not show a permitted route across nearby private land or railway property.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Root River map 2 and public water-access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: The DNR coordinate is retained at the wooded river edge near the Thompson Creek confluence. The exact landing and approach under canopy are unresolved. The inventory identifies the City of Hokah as the operator; do not imply DNR operates this city site.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the city carry-in on the north side of Hokah near County Road 7. DNR identifies the right bank facing downstream. Find the signed approach and identify the exit before launching; the nearby railway is not an access route.

sections.notes: A short lower Root paddle ending at Highway 26. Locate the left-bank exit before launching and finish before the river reaches the Mississippi. Check the abandoned railway bridge along the way.

notices.title: Railway bridge downstream of Hokah
notices.text: The DNR map identifies an abandoned railway bridge near mile 4.0. Check its current condition and leave room to assess the passage.

notices.title: Finish at Highway 26
notices.text: The river continues to the Mississippi downstream of this takeout. That continuation and its accesses are outside this listed trip.
